messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD#PD-81234) — svc-inference-eu high 5xx rate spike detected at 12:03 UTC. auto-escalation to oncall. details: https://pagerduty.example/PD-81234 — please ack and report.

pagerduty: PD Alert details — resource: svc-inference-eu, symptom: 5xx-rate > 15% for 2m, metric link: https://metrics.example/alerts/81234

alex_cheng: acked in PD, i'm on it. pulling logs and checking autoscaler + pods. will post findings.

maria_garcia: i'm oncall too, joining. k8s dashboard shows multiple pods crashlooping in eu cluster (replica set inference-deploy: 2/5 ready).

kevin_lee: any recent deploys before 12:00? i'm checking CI/CD — no infra deploys, but a model variant rollout happened ~11:50 (openquant-v2). grabbing image tags now.

jess: following runbook step 1/3. checking pod logs and mem usage. command I'm running: ```kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference --tail=200```

alex_cheng: restarted the failing pod to get a fresh trace: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/inference-deploy` — new pod starts but showing OOMKilled within ~30s. pasting last lines of log:
```
E 11:58:31 model_loader.cpp:482 MemoryError: failed allocating 1.2GB
E 11:58:31 inference_server.cpp:231 runtime error: KV cache allocation failed
```

maria_garcia: that log matches memory regression. openquant-v2 increases ram footprint due to fused kernels. i can roll back model variant to openquant-v1 (deployed 11:30) if we want immediate mitigation.

olivia_support: notified customers cust-239 and cust-512 via the status page and direct email. told them we're investigating and ETA ~30m. will update them after triage.

samir: i put a temporary route-rule to divert new traffic for eu to us-west (graceful degrade) to reduce pressure while we fix — needs confirmation to keep for 15m. command used: `curl -X POST https://console.routing/api/route-switch -d '{"from":"eu","to":"us-west","weight":0.3}'`

jess: doing controlled rollback of model variant on canary hosts now. steps: 1) scale down canary to 0, 2) promote openquant-v1. command:```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://console.example/api/models/promote -d '{"model":"openquant-v1","target":"inference-eu"}'```

kevin_lee: starting rollback of model artifact sha `abc123` -> `9f4b7` (openquant-v1). I'm toggling the canary flag and watching memory metrics.

incident-bot: PD update: alert acknowledged by alex_cheng. next notification scheduled every 5 minutes. PD incident link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-81234/incident

alex_cheng: rollback in progress, rolling pods are getting stable. memory usage on new pods back to baseline for the first two replicas. will keep watch for 2 cycles (10m). i'll take ownership and hand off if stable.

jess: logs show GC spikes stopped after model revert. pasted short sample: ```I 12:06:28 memory: rss 1.8GB -> 1.1GB; requests p95 latency stable```

maria_garcia: confirmed: 503/5xx rates dropping from 18% -> 3% in the last 4 minutes. marking preliminary mitigation as success.

samir: leaving the eu->us-west route diversion at 20% for another 10m to smooth traffic. planning to remove once 15m sustained low error rate.

olivia_support: updated status page: "Mitigation in progress — model rollback applied. Partial customer impact for some EU customers, next update in 15 minutes."

alex_cheng: taking handoff — i'll own incident for the next 30m. if error rate holds <5% for 15m, i'll close PD. status pings every 5m from me. :eyes:

samir: if we see reoccurence after reopen, action item: add memory guardrails to model promotion pipeline and a post-deploy smoke check for rss. I'll draft the postmortem checklist. :white_check_mark:

maria_garcia: noted. adding owners in ticket: alex_cheng (primary), samir (follow-up), kevin_lee (rollback), jess (runbook).

alex_cheng: 12:10 UTC - 5m status ping: error rate stable at ~2.6%, latency normal. continuing watch. will update again at +5m.

incident-bot: PD note: alex_cheng acknowledged, incident remains open. next automated reminder in 5m.
